reuse.why: Fintegra links through the existing finishLinkingAccount helper and every provider calls the new ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked guard, but the Fintegra downloader is a copy of Akahu's and the takeover reset re-writes unlinkAccount's field reset.

duplication.why: downloadFintegraTransactions copies downloadAkahuTransactions and the eight-field unlink reset is repeated from unlinkAccount.

placement.why: Guard and link handler sit in accounts/app.ts, downloader in sync.ts and base path in server-config.ts, matching the tree; the guard named ensure...IsNotLinked also performs the takeover write.

scope.why: Only the four requested behaviours and their tests are touched.

maintainability.why: A single guard for all providers and reuse of finishLinkingAccount are easy to own; the copied downloader and the side-effecting guard are the main costs.

bypasses_abstraction.where: ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked in accounts/app.ts re-implements the local unlink reset of unlinkAccount instead of sharing it.

disguised_duplication.where: downloadFintegraTransactions in sync.ts is downloadAkahuTransactions condensed onto fewer lines with the 'error' branch dropped, rather than a shared downloader.

abstraction_drift.where: ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked gained replaceExistingLink (step 4) and a general closed-account check (step 3), applied uniformly; finishLinkingAccount is used unchanged by Fintegra. SimpleFin, Pluggy, Akahu and EnableBanking still keep their own pre-existing link bodies, not introduced by this change.
